decisions.rationale: Remote Signal keys (PR #48): strictly opt-in via NewRemoteSignalClient, no hidden network or key exfiltration, default paths unchanged. Not integrated: it is a new key trust boundary that needs an owner decision, the five commits must be taken as a unit, and it depends on isTypedNil/InjectNode from the shadow series.
risks: AppStateKeyShare applied without the IsFromMe gate.
Signed prekey signature from RemoteIdentity is not verified locally.
decryptMessagesRemote copies a stale decrypt path (ack before dispatch, ignores handlerFailed, no meta decrypt-fail fallback).
SendPrebuiltStanza and remote resends bypass the fork's BeforeMessageWrite guard.
Unbounded remoteMigratedPN map; ADV secret rotation is local only; zero private keys persisted without a RemoteKeys sentinel.
tests: Probe cherry-picks with shims: build, vet, test and race passed; worktree reset, nothing applied.

policy.official_policy: Review the complete official range, merge it on a review branch, and validate conflicts and tests before publishing.
policy.hypermeow_policy: Treat every commit as untrusted. Integrate only an exact SHA approved by the AI review, using cherry-pick --no-commit.
policy.consumer_policy: Applications must pin a published WhatsFuck pseudo-version and must never update either upstream directly.
